title: Guided-RLVR: Guided Exploration in Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards
abstract: arXiv:2610.37041v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has shown strong empirical gains in improving the reasoning ability of large language models (LLMs) on tasks such as mathematics and programming. However, recent studies have shown that RLVR rollouts often collapse onto a narrow set of reasoning trajectories, limiting the explored reasoning space. Motivated by findings that thinking tokens at critical steps serve as critical structural elements in LLM reasoning pathways, we propose Guided-RLVR, a novel approach that augments RLVR with a lightweight controller. The controller strategically injects semantically meaningful steering tokens into the sampling distribution, encouraging the model to approach problems from multiple reasoning perspectives and thereby expanding the exploration space. translated_title: Guided-RLVR：可验证奖励强化学习中的引导式探索
translated_abstract: 可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR）在提升大语言模型（LLM）在数学和编程等任务上的推理能力方面已展现出显著的实证收益。然而，近期研究表明，RLVR 的采样往往坍缩到一小部分推理轨迹上，限制了所探索的推理空间。受“关键步骤中的思考标记是 LLM 推理路径中关键结构要素”这一发现的启发，我们提出了 Guided-RLVR，这是一种通过轻量级控制器增强 RLVR 的新方法。该控制器在采样分布中策略性地注入语义上有意义的引导标记，鼓励模型从多个推理视角切入问题，从而扩大探索空间。在数学推理和代码生成基准上的实验表明，Guided-RLVR 在持续超越现有 RLVR 方法的同时……
tldr: 提出 Guided-RLVR，通过轻量级控制器在采样分布中注入语义引导标记，扩展 RLVR 的推理探索空间，从而在数学推理和代码生成任务上持续超越现有 RLVR 方法。
en_tdlr: Guided-RLVR augments RLVR with a lightweight controller that injects semantically meaningful steering tokens into the sampling distribution, expanding the exploration space and consistently outperforming existing RLVR methods on math reasoning and code generation benchmarks.
